Subject: Renewal & expansion — quick recap and next steps

Hi Jamal / Samantha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap of what we heard and a few asks so we can harden the renewal/expansion proposal: 

1) Current usage (rough, please confirm):
   - Core chat route (prod): ~120M tokens/month
   - Summarization route (batch): ~250M tokens/month
   - New NER route (POC): ~60M tokens/month (expected to scale)

2) Near-term expansion plans you mentioned:
   - Move NER into prod in Q4 with an expected ramp to 200–300M tokens/mo by Q2 next year
   - Add multi-model route for higher-quality responses (costly per token but lower latency needs)

3) Procurement/Budget signals: you said procurement is targeting a target unit-economics range of ~$18–$22 per 1M tokens (blended) for the first-year commit. Confirm? Also noted potential for a reserved capacity commit if we can show predictable unit economics.

As next steps, can you:
- Confirm the current month-by-route token numbers (prod vs. batch vs. POC) — a 1–2 line reply is fine.
- Confirm the target blended $/1M tokens range you can sign up for (is $18–$22 accurate?), and whether you can consider a stepped commit (e.g., 250M / 750M / 1B tiers over a 12-mo period).

Dev & Neha — looping you in to propose blended step-up pricing and any routing/model-add costs. I’ll put together an initial blended quote once we have Jamal’s confirmation.

Thanks,

— Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Thanks Marissa — good writeup. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Current month-by-route (last 30 days):
  * Core chat (prod): 115M tokens
  * Summarization (batch): 260M tokens
  * NER (POC): 58M tokens (Q4 push to prod expected)

- Budget / unit economics: procurement is pushing for $18–$22 / 1M tokens blended for year-1. Ideally closer to $18 if we commit to step-ups (they want a simple stepped schedule).

- Procurement timeline: they want a 30–45 day procurement window after we provide a signed SOW + pricing. I’ve attached the procurement timeline doc we use internally.

- Questions for you: what does Redwood consider a "blended" rate vs. a tiered committed rate? Also, any additional per-model premium for higher-quality variants (we plan to add a high-quality route for clinical summarization) — ballpark numbers appreciated.

I’ll bring this to procurement next week — if you can get a blended quote + step-up tiers by EOD that would be great.

Thanks,
Jamal

Hi Jamal / team —

Thanks for the details. Below is a concrete blended/tiered proposal we can put on the SOW. These are ballpark public-facing numbers; Marissa will follow up with an official PDF quote and term-sheet.

Blended / step-up structure (12-month renewal + expansion):
- Tier A: 0–250M tokens/month: $20 per 1M tokens
- Tier B: 250M–750M tokens/month: $16 per 1M tokens
- Tier C: >750M tokens/month: $12 per 1M tokens

Example blended math (estimates):
- If you average ~400M tokens/mo across the year with a ramp, blended comes to ~$17.2 / 1M tokens.

Per-route / model add-ons (ballpark):
- High-quality clinical summarization variant: +$4 / 1M tokens above blended (to cover model execution cost)
- Low-latency/high-availability routing (dedicated capacity): +$3 / 1M tokens (can be applied to single route)

Notes / options:
- We can convert this to committed monthly token tiers (reserve X tokens per month) to secure lower effective blended rates.
- Step-up schedule (example): commit to 250M/mo for months 1–3, 500M/mo months 4–9, 800M/mo months 10–12 — pricing will reflect the commit schedule and produce a blended rate in the $14–$18 range depending on exact tiers.

I’ve attached a formal PDF quote and a short terms spreadsheet for procurement to review. If you want, we can also produce a route-by-route cost table showing per-model premiums.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwoodinference.com
